units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 146a:8">B. Bath. 146ᵃ</cite> <he>שחקי ליה מ׳ וכ׳</he> they ground for him a pearl worth &c.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 26b:2">Kidd. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>תלה בה מ׳ וכ׳</he> he set in it (the needle) a pearl (or a precious stone) worth &c.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 18a:13">Ib. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>נקיט מ׳ בידיה</he> he possessed a pearl (a precious slave).
<cite ref="Berakhot 33b:14">Ber. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>תקינו לן מ׳</he> they composed for us a precious prayer.
<cite ref="Yevamot 94a:11">Yeb. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>הרה ליה</he> … <he>למדרש ביה מ׳</he> R. E. had an opportunity for a most precious interpretation, opp. <he>חספא</he>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 92b:8">Ib. 92ᵇ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="D00828"><he>דְּלֵי</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M02506"><he>מַרְגַּנְיָיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 23a:10">R. Hash. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>מסקן מ׳</he> they bring up pearls (from the bottom of the sea).
